_note: Snapshot of the headline figures from 'Poisoning Attacks on LLMs Require a Near-constant Number of Poison Samples' (UK AI Security Institute, Anthropic, Alan Turing Institute; arXiv:2510.07192, Oct 2025). 250 poisoned documents (~420,000 tokens) backdoor models from 600M to 13B parameters, despite the largest training on >20x more clean data. Clean-data volume per model is Chinchilla-optimal (~20 tokens/parameter), which reproduces the paper's reported 0.00016% share at 13B (21000 / 13e9). carliniFraction is the 0.01% web-scale-poisoning share shown purchasable for ~$60 in arXiv:2302.10149.
